programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous. - Rob Dyrdek, Sterling Brim (Comedy, Entertainment, Reality, Show)

The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show. (Sports talk)

programme.title: First Take (Live)
programme.desc: Stephen A. Smith hosts this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment. (Sports talk, News, Debate)

programme.title: The Pat McAfee Show (Live)
programme.desc: Former NFL punter Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor to the microphone to highlight the day's top stories. (Sports talk)

programme.title: Big Day With Peter Schrager (Live)
programme.desc: Peter Schrager's daily show will feature rotating panelists focusing heavily on the NFL while also providing coverage of other major sports stories. (Football)

programme.title: NBA Today (Live)
programme.desc: In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts. (Sports talk, Basketball)

programme.title: NFL Live (Live)
programme.desc: Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL. (Football)

programme.title: SportsCenter (Live)
programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live "SportsCenter" morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms. (News, Sports talk)

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption (Live)
programme.desc: The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day. (Sports talk)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful
programme.desc: A grease monkey's (Eric Stoltz) tomboy friend (Mary Stuart Masterson) helps him woo a popular girl (Lea Thompson) in their Los Angeles high school.

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies.

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. - Amanda Bynes, James Kirk, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, Emily Perkins (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Our Ghosts
programme.desc: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. - Michele Riondino, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Pierobon, Orlando Forte, Alessandro Haber (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Free Birds
programme.desc: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Members (Andre Gower, Robby Kiger) of a monster fan club meet Count Dracula, Wolfman, Frankenstein, the Mummy and Gill Man. - Andre Gower, Robby Kiger, Stephen Macht, Duncan Regehr, Tom Noonan (Horror, Adventure)

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back. - Juliette Binoche, Ralph Fiennes, Janet McTeer, Sophie Ward, Simon Shepherd (Drama)

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
programme.desc: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Monster Summer
programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: Show Dogs
programme.desc: After a failed attempt to recover a stolen baby panda, police dog Max reluctantly teams up with a human FBI agent named Frank. A hot tip leads Max and Frank to Las Vegas for the world's most exclusive dog show. To find the panda, Max goes undercover as a contestant to get the lowdown from his fellow canines. With help from their new friends, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of greedy smugglers. - Will Arnett, Natasha Lyonne, RuPaul, Omar Chaparro, Andy Beckwith (Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back. - Juliette Binoche, Ralph Fiennes, Janet McTeer, Sophie Ward, Simon Shepherd (Drama)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: The House of Mirth
programme.desc: Lily (Gillian Anderson) is a ravishing socialite who quickly discovers the precariousness of her position when her beauty and charm start attracting unwelcome interest and jealousy. She seeks a wealthy husband and, in trying to conform to social expectations, she misses her chance for real love with Lawrence Selden (Eric Stoltz). Her quest for a husband comes to a scandalous end when she is falsely accused of having an affair with a married man and is rejected by society and her friends. - Gillian Anderson, Eric Stoltz, Dan Aykroyd, Eleanor Bron, Terry Kinney (Historical drama)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: The Perfect Score
programme.desc: College is up next for a group of high-school friends, so Francesca (Scarlett Johansson), the most daring of the group, suggests they steal SAT questions in order to increase their odds of getting into good universities. Hoop star Desmond (Darius Miles), studly Kyle (Chris Evans), working-class Matty (Bryan Greenberg), stoner Roy (Leonardo Nam) and foxy Anna (Erika Christensen) sign on for the scheme. But getting into the test facility after hours proves trickier than any multiple-choice exam. - Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg, Scarlett Johansson, Darius Miles (Comedy)

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. - Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell, Randall Batinkoff, Andrew Lowery (Drama)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Young orphan Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back. - Juliette Binoche, Ralph Fiennes, Janet McTeer, Sophie Ward, Simon Shepherd (Drama)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom. - Charlie Carter, Sarah Lawn, Jo Price, Matthew Wolf (Documentary)

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Never Say Never
programme.desc: A young singing sensation prepares to dazzle the crowd at a sold-out show at Madison Square Garden. Legions of adoring Bieber fans scream as he takes center stage for a memorable night of music. Concert footage mixes with home videos of Justin playing drums and showcasing his talent. - Boyz II Men (Documentary)

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Based on the popular board game, this comedy begins at a dinner party hosted by Mr. Boddy, where he admits to blackmailing his visitors. These guests, who have been given aliases, are Mrs. Peacock, Miss Scarlet, Mr. Green, Professor Plum, Mrs. White and Col. Mustard. When Boddy turns up murdered, all are suspects, and together they try to figure out who is the killer. - Eileen Brennan, Martin Mull, Lesley Ann Warren, Tim Curry, Madeline Kahn (Mystery, Comedy)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: The School of Rock
programme.desc: Overly enthusiastic guitarist Dewey Finn (Jack Black) gets thrown out of his bar band and finds himself in desperate need of work. Posing as a substitute music teacher at an elite private elementary school, he exposes his students to the hard rock gods he idolizes and emulates -- much to the consternation of the uptight principal (Joan Cusack). As he gets his privileged and precocious charges in touch with their inner rock 'n' roll animals, he imagines redemption at a local Battle of the Bands. - Jack Black, Joan Cusack, Mike White, Sarah Silverman, Jordan-Claire Green (Comedy, Music)

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? - Tom Hanks, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Stanley Tucci, Chi McBride, Diego Luna (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. - Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The School of Rock
programme.desc: Fired from his group and desperate for money, a guitarist (Jack Black) poses as a teacher for students who play in a school band.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: A shy man (Lance Bass) scours the streets of Chicago in search of a vivacious woman (Emmanuelle Chriqui) he met on a train.

programme.title: Love Means Zero
programme.desc: Tennis coach Nick Bollettieri's relentless desire to win at all costs leads to the destruction of an important relationship.

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Telling fortunes to support herself and her daughter, a psychic widow (Cate Blanchett) assists the police in a missing persons case.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: Jennifer (Alicia Silverstone) is a lovely teen who has been hired to baby-sit the kids of Harry Tucker (J.T. Walsh) and his wife, Dolly (Lee Garlington). The Tuckers go to a party and proceed to get inebriated, with Mr. Tucker fantasizing about his beautiful babysitter. Meanwhile, Jack (Jeremy London), her boyfriend, and Mark (Nicky Katt), another guy interested in her, decide to spy on Jennifer at the Tucker house, with each young man also fixated on her. - Alicia Silverstone, Jeremy London, J.T. Walsh, Lee Garlington, Nicky Katt (Thriller)

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. - Scarlett Johansson, Jonathan Rhys-Meyers, Emily Mortimer, Matthew Goode, Brian Cox (Drama)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band. - Zoe Lister-Jones, Adam Pally, Fred Armisen, Susie Essman, Hannah Simone (Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: Clairvoyant Marina (Demi Moore) meets New York City butcher Leo Lemke (George Dzundza) while he is visiting her small town in North Carolina. When she then dreams about him, she believes it is a sign that he is her true love. She marries Leo and moves to his working-class neighborhood in New York City. There she meets his neighbors, including shy singer Stella (Mary Steenburgen) and psychiatrist Alex Tremor (Jeff Daniels). Soon Marina begins to wonder if she was wrong about her soul mate. - Demi Moore, Jeff Daniels, George Dzundza, Mary Steenburgen, Frances McDormand (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict. - Susan Sarandon, Sean Penn, Robert Prosky, Raymond J. Barry, R. Lee Ermey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Anthony Mackie, Jay Baruchel (Drama)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Duplex
programme.desc: A writer named Alex (Ben Stiller) and his girlfriend, Nancy (Drew Barrymore), move into a spacious duplex in Brooklyn, N.Y. The elderly woman (Eileen Essell) who lives on the building's top floor seems a sweet enough neighbor at first. But pretty soon her constant demands and accidents ruin Alex and Nancy's attempts at having the perfect home. Once they discover that the woman cannot be evicted, they resort to more permanent measures to get rid of her. - Ben Stiller, Drew Barrymore, Eileen Essell, Harvey Fierstein, Justin Theroux (Comedy)

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser. (Documentary)

programme.title: Like Water for Chocolate
programme.desc: The youngest daughter in her family, the beautiful Tita is forbidden to marry her true love, Pedro. Since tradition dictates that Tita must care for her mother, Pedro weds her older sister, Rosaura, though he still loves Tita. The situation creates much tension in the family, and Tita's powerful emotions begin to surface in fantastical ways through her cooking. As the years pass, unusual circumstances test the enduring love of Pedro and Tita. - Lumi Cavazos, Marco Leonardi, Regina Torné, Mario Iván Martínez, Ada Carrasco (Romance, Drama, Books & literature)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: This is the true story of Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) and her husband Diego Rivera (Alfred Molina), the larger-than-life painters who became the most acclaimed artists in Mexican history, and whose tempestuous love affair, landmark journeys to America, and outrageous personalities made them legendary. - Salma Hayek, Alfred Molina, Geoffrey Rush, Mía Maestro, Ashley Judd (Biography, Drama, Romance, Historical drama)

programme.title: Ask the Dust
programme.desc: Arturo Bandini is a writer who moves from Colorado to Los Angeles with aspirations of completing a great novel. There he meets bold Mexican waitress Camilla. She wants to live a better life and thinks marrying for money may be her answer. Arturo, who tries to project a confidence that he is inwardly lacking, initially acts coldly toward Camilla. Despite not seeming like a viable match, a romance gradually develops between the two. - Colin Farrell, Salma Hayek, Donald Sutherland, Idina Menzel, William Mapother (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter. - Melissa Barrera, Jackie Cruz, Kristen Gutoskie, Luis Bordonada, Lisandra Tena (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Kokomo City
programme.desc: Four Black transgender sex workers tell their life stories in intimate and candid interviews. (Documentary)

programme.title: Duplex
programme.desc: A writer named Alex (Ben Stiller) and his girlfriend, Nancy (Drew Barrymore), move into a spacious duplex in Brooklyn, N.Y. The elderly woman (Eileen Essell) who lives on the building's top floor seems a sweet enough neighbor at first. But pretty soon her constant demands and accidents ruin Alex and Nancy's attempts at having the perfect home. Once they discover that the woman cannot be evicted, they resort to more permanent measures to get rid of her. - Ben Stiller, Drew Barrymore, Eileen Essell, Harvey Fierstein, Justin Theroux (Comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton (Drama, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. - Mila Kunis, Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn, Cheryl Hines, Christine Baranski (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Found terrified and alone in rural Louisiana, Nell Sweetzer is now safely in New Orleans. She can't remember the terrible events of the previous months, only that she is the only surviving member of her family. Nell wants to start a new life for herself, but just as she begins the difficult process, the evil force that once possessed her returns -- bringing with it unimaginably horrific plans that mean her last exorcism was just the beginning. - Ashley Bell, Julia Garner, Spencer Treat Clark, Louis Herthum, David Jensen (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: In order to keep one of his mistresses, Celia (Polly Walker), at arm's length, King Charles II (Sam Neill) asks the royal physician, Robert Merivel (Robert Downey Jr.), to marry her under the proviso that they never become intimate. Merivel agrees, only to discover he can't resist Celia, and soon finds himself out of the king's favor. Destitute, he devotes himself to helping Londoners suffering from the plague, and in the process falls in love with an equally poor woman, Katharine (Meg Ryan). - Robert Downey Jr., Sam Neill, David Thewlis, Polly Walker, Meg Ryan (Drama, Historical drama, Romance)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. - Mary J. Blige, Nat Wolff, David Zayas, Anika Noni Rose, Demetrius Grosse (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts. - Elena Kampouris, Jeremy Piven, Sean Astin, Travis Nelson, Bradley Stryker (Thriller)

programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death.

programme.title: Sliver
programme.desc: A book editor (Sharon Stone) has an affair with a voyeur (William Baldwin) in her building, a Manhattan murder scene wired for video.

programme.title: Organ Trail
programme.desc: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

programme.title: Paid Programming

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain - Glamorgan Sausage
programme.desc: Adam is in Glamorgan for the Glamorgan Sausage; he also tucks into more traditional fare, eating Welsh lamb faggots, Welsh rarebit and Welsh cakes before biting into his Polish heritage with a plate of perfect pierogies. (Travel)

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain - Cheddar
programme.desc: Adam eats cheddar in Cheddar before traveling to a farm café for roast chicken and a cheesy celeriac and leek bake, stopping at a vending machine for chocolate milk and tucking into a quiche from a mother-daughter bakery. (Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Cheesy Rider
programme.desc: S4E8 - Noah visits the Prince William County Fair in Manassas, Va. and tries the Monumental Grilled Cheese and the Chesapeake Bay Poutine; at the Western Fair in London, Ontario, he dives into a Poutine Dog, the Macaroni Bowl and Cherry Cheesecake Tempura. - Matthew Braun (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Toastbusters
programme.desc: S7E11 - Noah Cappe makes short work of the Smoke Bomb and the French Toast Crunch Burger; Blue Bacon Cheesecake; the annual Santa Maria Valley Strawberry Festival has inspired sweet berry treats like the Pizza Berry Pie and the Strawberry Crisp Corn Dog. (Cooking, Travel, Documentary)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Jackie Hash Brown
programme.desc: S8E5 - At the world-famous Iowa State Fair, sampling some award-winning new food items. There's a new take on chicken and waffles and a massive meat meal all wrapped up to eat on the midway: the Pork-Tato, the Hash Brown Handful. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - The Devil Wears Pasta
programme.desc: S7E8 - At the Okeechobee County Fair, Noah samples hot-wing grilled cheese, a sweet bacon Devil Burger and strawberry margarita funnel cake; the Scarborough Renaissance Festival in Texas has ooey-gooey pasta roses and homemade cinnamon rolls with bacon. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - From Dusk Dill Donut
programme.desc: S11E5 - Noah Cappe takes on the dill donut sundae at the South Florida Fair in West Palm Beach, a BBQ lumpia sandwich at the Washington County Fair in Utah and the cereal-infused Saturday Morning Pizza at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Carnival Eats - Uncut Grape Gems
programme.desc: S11E7 - Noah Cappe visits the Washington County Fair in Utah for the Twisted Pickle Roll -- a deep-fried pickle sushi dream come true -- and has a little dessert in the desert with the Cookie Dough Dog. Then, he's off to the Clark County Fair in Nevada for Pretzel French Toast and the spicy Cheesy Carne Brick. Finally, Noah heads to the North Florida Fair in Tallahassee for their Southern Fried Softshell Sandwich, the Fiery Fiesta Funnel Cake and Grape Gems, a candy-coated fruity treat! (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Surf and Turf
programme.desc: S2E9 - The best surf-and-turf dishes in restaurants across America, including the classic lobster tail and steak, clam and bacon pizza, crab cakes with sausage, and even a lobster-and-steak roll. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Global Grub
programme.desc: S3E6 - Roger Mooking takes 15 gastronomical trips for the most exotic, flavorful and spicy foods all without leaving the U.S.; The featured chefs create classic international meals from Ethiopia, Thailand, Mexico and more in their own American kitchens. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Pub Grub
programme.desc: S4E4 - Roger Mooking goes on a pub crawl to find 15 of the best dishes to go with any drink; chicken wings, nachos, sliders, apps and mains -- they're all here; chefs share insider tips and tricks for making the very best, tastiest bar fare. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Barbecue
programme.desc: S1E1 - Roger cannot resist the sweet, succulent smoky goodness of barbecue as he canvases the country on the lookout for the fifteen best barbecue dishes wherever he can find them. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Extra Crispy
programme.desc: S16E10 - An extra-crispy menu piled high with pork rind brisket nachos, spicy Korean double-fried chicken, authentic British fish and chips, inventive egg rolls, country-fried Wagyu burgers, fried soft-shell crab and some creative cookies. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Apps and Zerts
programme.desc: S16E13 - Pizza pretzels and duck empanadas handle the savory side, while cheesecake waffle sundaes and a big banana pudding bring the sweet. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Food Hall Frenzy
programme.desc: S14E34 - Food halls for gourmet eats on the go; there's gravy-smothered fried chicken biscuits and Vietnamese-Cajun cuisine in New Orleans; both New-York-style pizza and ice cream. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Grub on the Go
programme.desc: S14E36 - Top picks featuring a New Jersey drive-in slinging sky-high burgers, a New Orleans doughnut shop turning diner dinner classics into quick-bite handhelds, and a Southern California spot serving decadent seafood fries. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - BBQ in Big Cities
programme.desc: S7E8 - Bludso's Bar and Que in Los Angeles, where owner Kevin Bludso brings meat and heat to Tinseltown in a big way; Kevin loads up his massive smoker with brisket, pork ribs, and chicken to cook low and slow in oak and pecan smoke. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Texas BBQ
programme.desc: S2E7 - Two legendary BBQ places in Texas; a third-generation pit master. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Queens of 'Cue
programme.desc: S5E3 - Roger samples the smoked ribs at Mary's Old Fashioned Pit Bar-B-Que; Roger meets legendary pit master Helen Turner of Helen's Bar-B-Q in Brownsville, Tenn., and helps her cook pork shoulders, pork ribs and a whole stick of bologna. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - Fiery Fish and Fowl
programme.desc: S5E7 - Roger Mooking travels to North Bend, Ore., and meets up with Don Ivy, Chief of the Coquille Tribe for a traditional tribal feast; in Los Angeles, Roger visits Andy Ricker of Pok Pok La, who divulges the secrets to his famous whole roasted chicken. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - All You Can Feast
programme.desc: S5E8 - Roger Mooking and Charlie Thieriot slow roast a 30-pound porchetta; Roger assists caterers Jaret Foster and Mona Johnson in putting together roasted mussels and a white bean, chorizo and clam stew. (Cooking)

programme.title: Man Fire Food - The Salt and the Sea
programme.desc: S5E9 - Ben Jacobsen, owner of Jacobsen Salt Co., takes Roger on a tour of the facility and shows him how to smoke sea salt; Roger meets with chef Carlo Lamagna and helps him stuff a 20-pound halibut, encrust it in salt and roast it over a wood-burning fire. (Cooking)

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations - Colombia
programme.desc: S4E12 - Unknown foods of Colombia; seafood in Cartagena; market workers in Cecilia; the island of Tierra Bomba; fried pig intestines and boiled pig ears. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations - Brazil: The Amazon

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Big Time Brother Rebuild in Rhode Island
programme.desc: S1E10 - Business partner brothers look for a vacation home in Coventry, R.I., but the to-do list is long and the brothers quickly run into structural issues. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Wolf Lake Escape
programme.desc: S2E3 - New parents look to escape their busy New York City lives with a move to Wolf Lake, a small, rustic lake community in upstate New York; the properties they consider require significant renovations and may break the bank. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Lone Star State Update
programme.desc: S1E1 - After spending years living all over the world, Teresa and Jeremy find the perfect vacation home for their family in Texas. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Otter Tail Transformation
programme.desc: S3E4 - A family with three young kids finds its forever lake home in Otter Tail County, Minn.; however, it is far from turnkey and the massive and complex renovation may derail the lakeside living dreams. (House/garden, Home improvement)

programme.title: Barnwood Builders - Barnwood Cottage
programme.desc: S8E12 - The guys turn a new storage shed into an 1800s log cabin, then drive it to Round Top, Texas; Mark gets a lesson from a local silversmith; the team visits historic structures built around the state by 19th-century pioneers. (Reality, How-to, Home improvement, Documentary)

programme.title: Barnwood Builders - The Finished Product
programme.desc: S8E8 - Mark Bowe visits finished cabins he helped build in Montana, Texas, South Carolina, West Virginia, and North Carolina; a big surprise awaits Mark in Gatlinburg, Tenn. (Reality, How-to, Home improvement, Documentary)

programme.title: This Old House - Nashville: Grounded
programme.desc: S46E3 - Prefabricated walls are set in place; the house is moved back into place over its new foundation; a structural engineer solves a problem onsite; Nashville's famous hot chicken. (Home improvement, How-to, House/garden)

programme.title: This Old House - Nashville: A Grand Time at the Opry
programme.desc: S46E4 - Touring the Grand Ole Opry; framing begins at the project house and HVAC plans are revealed; plumbing penetrations on the roof are sealed and covered; a pocket door frame is installed. (Home improvement, How-to, House/garden)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Chase Hunts for an Italian Dream Home
programme.desc: S1E1 - The Maine Cabin Masters want to test their skills in Italy; Chase, Sarah and their four children set out house hunting in the remote Italian countryside. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Demolition and a New Italian Bathroom
programme.desc: S1E2 - Chase, Sarah, Ashley and Ryan have arrived in Italy for the long haul; they need to work with the locals to demolish the house and complete their first big project before the kids arrive - these kids will need a working bathroom. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Building Italy: Bedrooms and a Basement Floor
programme.desc: S1E3 - Chase has two big projects to juggle; the kids have big ideas for their four bedrooms on the second floor, while the basement has walls needing demolition and new floors that need to be poured if he's to keep on schedule for the future family room. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Sarah's Italian Dream Kitchen
programme.desc: S1E4 - The cabin masters and Morrill family take on their most ambitious project yet; Chase discovers local stoneworkers; he embraces the kids' artistic side; guests from Maine arrive to lend a hand. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - From Animal Stables to a New Family Room
programme.desc: S1E5 - Even with Ashley, Ryan and Jedi to help, Chase and family have a ton of work to do to turn their walkout basement into a family room complete with a new bathroom; only Chase could find a second life for old animal troughs. (Reality)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters: Building Italy - Exteriors and The Final Reveal
programme.desc: S1E6 - With two weeks left and a ton of work remaining, including exteriors, roofing, decking, landscaping and a missing bedroom, Chase, Ashley, Ryan, Sarah and the kids have to rally to finish the house. (Reality)

programme.title: Building Outside the Lines - Historic Granary Becomes a Goat Milk Goods Haven
programme.desc: S3E2 - Cappie and Alex relocate and restore a 120-year-old granary, transforming it into a rustic-yet-functional retail space for goat milk-based products -- honoring their clients' expanding farm with personal touches and plenty of space to grow. (Home improvement, House/garden)

programme.title: Building Outside the Lines - A Natural Pool Oasis for All Seasons
programme.desc: Cappie and Alex carve out a luxury natural swimming pool with a handmade boulder wall, eco-filtration and native landscaping to create an all-season oasis and the ultimate gathering spot for friends, family and guests. (Home improvement, House/garden)

programme.title: Building Outside the Lines - Rammed Earth Outdoor Kitchen
programme.desc: S2E11 - Former pub owners seek outdoor entertaining space; Cappie and Alex construct the kitchen area using a rammed earth method; the project aims to create a new hangout spot. (Home improvement, House/garden)

programme.title: Building Outside the Lines - Floating Island Oasis
programme.desc: S3E6 - Years after their client's DIY raft sinks, Cappie and Alex reprise the dream with a custom floating retreat for the whole family, complete with shade, seating, a fishing nook and a fire pit for summer fun on the lake. (Home improvement, House/garden)

programme.title: Building Outside the Lines - Shipping Container Into Instant Backyard Retreat
programme.desc: S3E7 - In South Dakota, Cappie and Alex transform a 20-foot shipping container into a stunning backyard space with barnwood accents, a misting system, and custom details -- creating a warm, inviting place to gather, relax, and celebrate. (Home improvement, House/garden)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Camp 'Contee Going Up
programme.desc: S7E13 - The masters remodel a 1960s cabin that needs more living space, but there's a catch: they can't build outside the original footprint. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Give a Dog a Camp
programme.desc: S8E3 - A man who recently inherited his dad's winter retreat wants to honor his father's memory while making the camp comfortable for year-round living for his family with a bigger bathroom, more inside light, a four-season porch, and space for their dogs. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Camp Lucky Seven
programme.desc: S8E9 - A group of brothers who inherited a rugged hunting cabin from their father and his friends enlist the team to restore it and preserve its legacy. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for Karly
programme.desc: S8E5 - Kristin's family has owned this cabin for five generations, but now would like to add on to the kitchen and raise the roof to comfortably fit her husband and son, and add more space for their daughter to enjoy the space with ease. (Reality, Home improvement, House/garden, How-to)

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Mow the House Down

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Blank Slate Build for Mom

programme.title: Barnwood Builders - American Muscle
programme.desc: S9E2 - The builders create a timber-frame barn for a private collection of American muscle cars in Columbus, Texas; Mark visits one of the biggest barns he's ever seen, finds the oldest live oak tree in the state and explores some local history.

programme.title: This Old House - Nashville: Sustainable Siding
programme.desc: S46E5 - Visiting a factory where siding is made from rice hulls, then installing it at the project house; brick repairs are done on the interior.

programme.title: This Old House - Nashville: Vince Gill's Nashville

programme.desc: S6E8 - A family finds the perfect lakefront location with a not-so-perfect house in Vermont. Their carpentry skills come in handy for the full gut renovation, as costly foundation repairs add up.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Northern Michigan
programme.desc: S6E9 - A married couple from Detroit own a rental property in Northern Michigan, but with steady bookings and busy lives, they rarely get to enjoy it. Now they're looking for a vacation escape to share with family and friends whenever they want.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Cozy Cottage on Lake Ontario in Need of Some Hard Work and TLC
programme.desc: S6E7 - Empty nesters search for a cozy cottage they can make their own along Lake Ontario's sprawling New York shoreline. With a modest budget, they aren't afraid of a fixer-upper, but they are hopeful they can find something with direct lakefront access.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A New Start for Two Retirees on Michigan's Duck Lake
programme.desc: S6E2 - A retired military couple wants to move from Maryland to find a forever home n Michigan's Duck Lake. They're willing to put in some sweat equity for renovations with hopes they can inspire their children and grandchildren to make frequent visits.

programme.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Best Buds Build Big on Deep Creek Lake Maryland
programme.desc: S6E4 - Two best friends and business partners have flipped many houses together, but now they plan to renovate one for themselves. Lake property here is pricey, so these buyers will look for a bargain that they can transform into the perfect lake escape.

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot (Live)
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel. (Sports talk, Talk)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Batman and his new ally Wonder Woman recruit Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash to help them save the planet from a newly awakened enemy.

programme.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice: Ultimate Edition
programme.desc: Convinced that Superman (Henry Cavill) is now a threat to humanity, Batman (Ben Affleck) embarks on a personal vendetta to end his reign on Earth, while the conniving Lex Luthor (Jesse Eisenberg) launches his own crusade against the Man of Steel.

programme.title: Shot Heard 'Round the World (New)
programme.desc: Bobby Thomson's dramatic home run ends the 1951 National League baseball playoff between the New York Giants and the Brooklyn Dodgers.

programme.title: The Day Sports Stood Still (New)
programme.desc: Documenting the previously unprecedented sports shutdown in March 2020 in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic and the events that followed, including athlete interviews and insights from team owners and NBA staff.

programme.title: About Face: Supermodels Then and Now
programme.desc: Carmen Dell'Orefice, Carol Alt, Isabella Rossellini, Christie Brinkley, Beverly Johnson and other models discuss their groundbreaking careers.

programme.title: Breaking In
programme.desc: A woman takes her two children on a weekend getaway to her late father's secluded, high-tech estate in the countryside. She soon finds herself in a desperate fight to save all of their lives when four men break into the house to find hidden money.

programme.title: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: The 1973 tennis match between Billie Jean King and Bobby Riggs became the most watched televised sports event of all time. While trapped in the media glare, King and Riggs fight more personal and complex battles.

programme.title: Tusk
programme.desc: A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

programme.title: Undertone
programme.desc: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Truth or Dare
programme.desc: A game of truth or dare results in fatalities when an unknown entity penalizes participants for lying or declining challenges.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

programme.title: Barbarian
programme.desc: A young woman discovers the rental home she booked is already occupied by a stranger. Against her better judgment, she decides to spend the night but soon discovers there's a lot more to fear than just an unexpected house guest.

programme.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: A washed-up actor (Michael Keaton), whose previous claim to fame was his portrayal of a popular superhero, attempts to recapture his past glory by mounting a Broadway play.

programme.title: Ice Age: Continental Drift
programme.desc: Scrat's pursuit of an infernal acorn has world-changing consequences for Manny (Ray Romano), Diego (Denis Leary) and Sid (John Leguizamo).

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Reluctant to dance, the son of Mumble (Elijah Wood) the tap-dancing penguin runs away from home and meets a penguin that can fly.

programme.title: The Legend of Ochi
programme.desc: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear elusive animals known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

programme.title: Amy
programme.desc: Archival footage and personal testimonials present an intimate portrait of the life and career of British singer/songwriter Amy Winehouse.

programme.title: Marc by Sofia
programme.desc: Sofia Coppola captures the genius and singular universe of iconic American fashion designer Marc Jacobs.

programme.title: Very Ralph
programme.desc: Fashion icon Ralph Lauren speaks candidly in extensive interviews about his childhood, his five-decade-long marriage, and how he translated his vision and inspiration into one of the world's most widely recognized brands.

programme.title: About Face: Supermodels Then and Now
programme.desc: Carmen Dell'Orefice, Carol Alt, Isabella Rossellini, Christie Brinkley, Beverly Johnson and other models discuss their groundbreaking careers.

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
programme.desc: Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows Spinal Tap as they prepare for a reunion concert. Joined by Paul McCartney and Elton John, they wrestle with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in rock 'n' roll history.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Teens (Bruce Campbell, Ellen Sandweiss, Betsy Baker) in a remote cabin accidentally resurrect demonic forces with a taped incantation and the Book of the Dead.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: At a remote forest cabin, five friends discover a Book of the Dead and unwittingly summon an ancient demon. The malevolent entity possesses each person in succession, until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

programme.title: Life of the Party
programme.desc: Dumped by her husband, longtime housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Winding up at the same school as her daughter, Deanna plunges headlong into the campus experience -- embracing the fun, the freedom and the frat boys.

programme.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
programme.desc: Tennessee Williams' Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) moves in with her sister, Stella (Kim Hunter), and brutish brother-in-law, Stanley Kowalski (Marlon Brando).

programme.title: The A List: 15 Stories From Asian and Pacific Diasporas
programme.desc: A tapestry of personal vignettes from across the Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander, also known as the AANHPI, communities in America.

programme.title: MoviePass, MovieCrash
programme.desc: Exploring the company's founding and the implosion that occurred after outside investors took over, rendering the company bankrupt and under investigation.
